summary: Yarrow Bioscience, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on underwritten offering of 5,769,231 common shares at $26.00 per share, grossing $150.0 million before a 6% underwriting discount ($9.0 million) and roughly $141.0 million net. The pricing reflects a 10.7% discount to the September 9, 2026 last sale of $29.11. Jefferies, TD Cowen and Guggenheim are joint book-runners, with LifeSci Capital as lead manager. Settlement is expected September 14, 2026, and a 30-day option covers 865,384 additional shares. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch deal pricing pressure and use of proceeds.
